no-args-shows-help.stdout:
{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {
    "usage": "Outrank CLI

Agent-first CLI for Outrank's public agent API.

Usage:
  outrank-cli <group> <command> [options]
  outrank-cli <group> --help

Groups:
  auth        Store or verify API-key authentication.
  products    List, create, inspect, and configure products, integrations, article settings, Google Search Console, linking, and backlinks.
  keywords    Inspect, check write status, add, reschedule, delete, suggest, generate, and export keyword plans.
  articles    Inspect article metadata and bodies, edit content, retry publish, precreate, and generate.
  improvements Discover, brief, schedule, run, review, and publish article improvements for existing posts.
  marketplace Seller onboarding, eligibility, placements, earnings, Stripe payouts, and buyer setup for the Outrank Marketplace.
  subscription Inspect plan, trial, quota, and add-on status.
  usage       Inspect current usage and quota consumption.
  billing     Product-slot purchase flows.

Global Auth Options:
  --api-key <key>      Override the API key for this command only.
  --base-url <url>     Override the Outrank base URL for this command only.

JSON Input Conventions:
  Complex write commands accept one of:
  --json '<object>'
  --json-file payload.json
  --json-stdin

Examples:
  outrank-cli auth login outr_live_xxx
  outrank-cli auth whoami
  outrank-cli products list --limit 20
  outrank-cli keywords list --product <UUID-1> --scope all
  outrank-cli articles list --product <UUID-1> --status published
  outrank-cli improvements candidates list <UUID-1> --type ctr_gap
  outrank-cli improvements tasks execute <UUID-1>
  outrank-cli subscription status
  outrank-cli usage stats
  outrank-cli products create --json-file product.json
  outrank-cli billing portal-url
  outrank-cli products integrations list <UUID-1>
  outrank-cli products output-settings update <product-id> --json-file output-settings.json
  outrank-cli products target-audiences replace <product-id> --json-file target-audiences.json
  outrank-cli products gsc connect <product-id>
  outrank-cli products gsc performance <product-id>
  outrank-cli products linking sources get <product-id>
  outrank-cli products backlinks get <product-id>
  outrank-cli products backlinks earned <product-id> --limit 20 --include-article
  outrank-cli billing purchase-products quote --additional-products 2
  outrank-cli marketplace seller status <product-id>
  outrank-cli marketplace seller onboard <product-id> --country US
  outrank-cli marketplace seller placements list <product-id> --status needs_approval"
  },
  "agent_guidance": "Choose a command group, then run that group with --help for detailed usage."
}

mcp-help.stdout:
{
  "ok": true,
  "data": {
    "usage": "Usage:
  outrank-cli mcp [--toolsets <names|all|auto>] [--read-only] [--profile <name>] [--upload-dir <directory>]

Starts the Outrank MCP server on stdio. Every CLI command except auth login, auth logout and auth profiles is
exposed as a tool whose name is the command with underscores (products integrations list -> products_integrations_list).

Options:
  --toolsets <names>    Comma-separated toolsets to expose, or all. Default: auto (from the organization's
                        entitlements, plus the setup tools of every area).
                        Toolsets: core, integrations, gsc, linking, backlinks, keywords, articles, improvements,
                        marketplace-seller, marketplace-buyer, billing.
  --read-only           Expose only tools that do not change anything.
  --profile <name>      Use a stored profile (one per organization). See: outrank-cli auth profiles
  --upload-dir <dir>    Directory image uploads may be read from. Default: the directory the server starts in.

Environment:
  OUTRANK_API_KEY           API key, unless a profile is selected.
  OUTRANK_PROFILE           Same as --profile.
  OUTRANK_MCP_TOOLSETS      Same as --toolsets.
  OUTRANK_MCP_READ_ONLY=1   Same as --read-only.
  OUTRANK_MCP_UPLOAD_DIR    Same as --upload-dir.
  OUTRANK_MCP_DEBUG=1       Log tool calls to stderr (never headers; secrets are redacted).

Notes:
  The key is never a tool argument. A base URL outside outrank.so is accepted only when the key and the URL come
  from the same stored profile.

Examples:
  claude mcp add outrank --env OUTRANK_API_KEY=outr_live_xxx -- npx -y outrank-cli mcp
  outrank-cli mcp --profile acme --toolsets core,keywords,articles --read-only"
  },
  "agent_guidance": "Register this command as a stdio MCP server in the client configuration; do not run it interactively."
}
